requiredSecrets.notes: Standard PostgreSQL connection string format. Used for both app data and session storage.

requiredSecrets.description: Secret key for session encryption and signing (minimum 32 characters for security)
requiredSecrets.validation: Must be at least 32 characters long
requiredSecrets.notes: Critical for cookie-based session security. Used for express-session encryption and CSRF protection.

requiredSecrets.description: Admin portal login password (use a strong password)
requiredSecrets.notes: Strong password required for cookie-based admin authentication. No username required.

requiredSecrets.description: Admin email address to receive appointment notifications and system alerts
requiredSecrets.notes: Primary email for receiving appointment notifications. Recommended: contact@handytech-solutions.com for IONOS hosting.

requiredSecrets.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails (IONOS recommended)
requiredSecrets.notes: For IONOS hosting: use smtp.ionos.com. Alternative providers: smtp.gmail.com, smtp-mail.outlook.com
Must be a valid email address configured with your SMTP provider. For IONOS: use your domain email.

requiredSecrets.description: SMTP authentication password or app-specific password
requiredSecrets.notes: For security, use app-specific passwords when available. IONOS: use your email account password.

optionalSecrets.description: OpenAI API key for AI-powered customer service chatbot
optionalSecrets.notes: If not provided, chatbot will use fallback responses. Required for full AI functionality.

optionalSecrets.description: Brevo (Sendinblue) API key for automated appointment reminder emails
optionalSecrets.notes: Required for automated email confirmations and reminders

optionalSecrets.description: Default sender email address for system emails
Business name displayed in emails and communications
Business phone number for customer communications
Base URL for the public-facing website used in email links
SMTP server port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL)
optionalSecrets.notes: IONOS supports both 587 (STARTTLS) and 465 (SSL). Recommended: 587 for better compatibility.

optionalSecrets.description: Calendly Personal Access Token for API integration
optionalSecrets.notes: Currently not active in production but available for integration

optionalSecrets.description: Calendly user URI (auto-fetched if not provided)
Calendly organization URI (auto-fetched if not provided)
Calendly webhook signing key for signature verification
Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins for production
optionalSecrets.notes: Required in production. No wildcards allowed for security. Development allows localhost automatically.

optionalSecrets.description: Legacy JWT secret (still used for some operations)
optionalSecrets.validation: Must be at least 32 characters long
optionalSecrets.notes: Fallback for JWT operations. Primary auth uses cookie sessions.

optionalSecrets.description: Legacy admin username (deprecated - not used in cookie auth)
optionalSecrets.notes: Deprecated in cookie-based auth system. Only ADMIN_PASS is required.
Legacy setting for JWT operations. Session-based auth uses express-session configuration.

security.rateLimiting: Multiple rate limiting tiers (public, sensitive, auth attempts)
security.corsPolicy: Environment-based CORS with production whitelist (no wildcards)
security.inputSanitization: XSS protection and input sanitization middleware
security.cookieSecurity: Secure httpOnly cookies with SameSite protection
security.productionHardening: Strict security policies enforced in production environment
security.magicLinkSecurity: Time-limited token authentication with automatic cleanup
